item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 05/Aug/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southwesterly airstream will bring showers to the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, an area of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the coast of Guangxi. With the anticyclone aloft over the northern part of the South China Sea strengthening, the weather will be very hot over the coast of Guangdong midweek next week. An upper-air disturbance is expected to bring thundery showers to southern China in the latter part of next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Khanun will move across the Ryukyu Islands today and tomorrow, and gradually edge closer to the vicinity of Kyushu and the western part of Honshu of Japan afterwards.
